headline: Binance targets full reopening of customer crypto withdrawals by next week
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance stated it is aiming to fully restore client withdrawal operations by next week following operational restrictions.
why: Binance is the world's largest digital asset exchange by spot trading volume.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Resolving customer withdrawal restrictions at the world's largest exchange reduces liquidity anxiety.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Announcing a clear timeline to restore withdrawal functionality relieved immediate solvency and liquidity concerns among digital asset traders.
